policy.entry: first fresh accepted top-of-book point while flat and without a live entry pair; join best bid and ask
policy.queueAhead: displayed quantity at the posted price at quote decision; reduce only by deduplicated, scoped public-print quantity at/through the limit with an inferred aggressor; book-size changes and cancellations never reduce queue
policy.aggressorInference: use the freshest captured same-market book with sourceAt at/before print execution and age no more than 10s; price at/below best bid implies sell aggressor, at/above best ask implies buy aggressor; inside-spread prints are ambiguous and excluded
policy.entryFill: one share only after eligible aggressor print volume exceeds the remaining displayed queue ahead; fill at the maker limit
policy.positionLimit: one active one-share position per market; first entry proxy cancels the opposite entry quote
policy.exit: one passive target quote one tick favorable to entry, with the same activation/lifetime and queue-depletion rule
policy.stress: one adverse tick per modeled fill; two ticks for a completed round trip, one tick for an unresolved entry fill marked to the executable side

limitations: Aggressor is inferred from event-time public quotes, not provided by the trade feed; ambiguous and stale-book prints are excluded.
Displayed quantity is a queue-ahead proxy; hidden liquidity, priority changes, feed loss, cancellations, and partial execution detail are not observed.
Print size at/through the limit is conservatively applied to the recorded queue; maker execution remains counterfactual and is not an actual fill.
No fees, rebates, queue latency, market impact, or order-cancel costs are modeled; the one-tick-per-fill stress does not establish a deployable edge.
